orbit join: verified orbit for linux/amd64 (sha256 5727cc2e9e9c9684cd04fb9ae3f255c8ee380752ac82c8e0a65fd9d307c991f6)
orbit join: responder app1; UE pools 10.250.0.0/16 via 198.51.100.1, N6 198.51.100.0/24
orbit join: N6 IP 198.51.100.21 on ens5 (from --n6-ip)
orbit join: control bind 192.0.2.20:9551 on ens4 (from the route to the server at 192.0.2.10; override with --bind)

Plan:
  1. install the verified orbit as /usr/local/lib/orbit/orbit (sha256 5727cc2e9e9c9684cd04fb9ae3f255c8ee380752ac82c8e0a65fd9d307c991f6)
  2. route UE pool 10.250.0.0/16 back through the UPF
       ip -4 route replace '10.250.0.0/16' via '198.51.100.1' dev 'ens5'
  3. firewall: allow control traffic (tcp) on ens4 from 192.0.2.10/32 to port 9551
       nft insert rule 'inet' 'filter' 'input' 'iifname "ens4" ip saddr 192.0.2.10/32 tcp dport 9551 accept comment "orbit-join control ens4 192.0.2.10/32 9551"'
       inserted into inet filter input (your ruleset)
  4. firewall: allow data traffic (tcp, udp) on ens5 from 10.250.0.0/16 to ports 32768-60999
       nft insert rule 'inet' 'filter' 'input' 'iifname "ens5" ip saddr 10.250.0.0/16 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 32768-60999 accept comment "orbit-join data ens5 10.250.0.0/16 32768-60999"'
       inserted into inet filter input (your ruleset)
       (data ports 32768-60999: this host's ephemeral range (net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range), since the responder's receivers bind ephemeral ports)
  5. firewall: allow data traffic (tcp, udp) on ens5 from 198.51.100.0/24 to ports 32768-60999
       nft insert rule 'inet' 'filter' 'input' 'iifname "ens5" ip saddr 198.51.100.0/24 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 32768-60999 accept comment "orbit-join data ens5 198.51.100.0/24 32768-60999"'
       inserted into inet filter input (your ruleset)
       (data ports 32768-60999: this host's ephemeral range (net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range), since the responder's receivers bind ephemeral ports)
  6. create the system user orbit, which the responder runs as
       useradd --system --user-group --no-create-home --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /usr/sbin/nologin orbit
  7. install /usr/local/lib/orbit/join-net.sh (run as root before the responder starts):
       | #!/bin/sh
       | # orbit join: re-applies the N6 route and firewall rules for orbit-responder.service.
       | set -eu
       | PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
       | ip -4 route replace '10.250.0.0/16' via '198.51.100.1' dev 'ens5'
       | nft list chain 'inet' 'filter' 'input' | grep -qF 'comment "orbit-join control ens4 192.0.2.10/32 9551"' || nft insert rule 'inet' 'filter' 'input' 'iifname "ens4" ip saddr 192.0.2.10/32 tcp dport 9551 accept comment "orbit-join control ens4 192.0.2.10/32 9551"'
       | nft list chain 'inet' 'filter' 'input' | grep -qF 'comment "orbit-join data ens5 10.250.0.0/16 32768-60999"' || nft insert rule 'inet' 'filter' 'input' 'iifname "ens5" ip saddr 10.250.0.0/16 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 32768-60999 accept comment "orbit-join data ens5 10.250.0.0/16 32768-60999"'
       | nft list chain 'inet' 'filter' 'input' | grep -qF 'comment "orbit-join data ens5 198.51.100.0/24 32768-60999"' || nft insert rule 'inet' 'filter' 'input' 'iifname "ens5" ip saddr 198.51.100.0/24 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 32768-60999 accept comment "orbit-join data ens5 198.51.100.0/24 32768-60999"'
  8. install /etc/systemd/system/orbit-responder.service:
       | [Unit]
       | Description=orbit N6 responder (orbit join)
       | Wants=network-online.target
       | After=network-online.target nftables.service iptables.service ip6tables.service netfilter-persistent.service
       | 
       | [Service]
       | User=orbit
       | Group=orbit
       | LoadCredential=responder.yaml:/etc/orbit/responder.yaml
       | ExecStartPre=+/usr/local/lib/orbit/join-net.sh
       | ExecStart=/usr/local/lib/orbit/orbit responder --config ${CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY}/responder.yaml
       | Restart=on-failure
       | RestartPreventExitStatus=78
       | NoNewPrivileges=yes
       | ProtectSystem=strict
       | ProtectHome=yes
       | PrivateTmp=yes
       | CapabilityBoundingSet=
       | RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_UNIX
       | 
       | [Install]
       | WantedBy=multi-user.target
  9. register the responder on this host with the server as app1 (credential: new)
       '/usr/local/lib/orbit/orbit' responder register --server 'https://192.0.2.10:8412' --pin 'sha256/47DEQpj8HBSa+/TImW+5JCeuQeRkm5NMpJWZG3hSuFU=' --token-file '<work>/token' --name 'app1' --control '192.0.2.20:9551' --data-ip '198.51.100.21' --data-ports '32768-60999' --config '/etc/orbit/responder.yaml'
       (the join token is read from a file in this run's private directory, mode 0600)
  10. enable and (re)start orbit-responder, then wait for the server to see it online
       systemctl enable orbit-responder
       systemctl restart orbit-responder
       '/usr/local/lib/orbit/orbit' responder check --config '/etc/orbit/responder.yaml' --wait 20s
